summary: Verified Wallbox SN Receipts lookup bug fix. Backend /api/inventory/lookup returns status=ok matched_by=sn_receipt for real SNs from Inventory Receipts, including single-serial cell (1427354 → Pulsar Pro Socket) and dot-separated multi-serial cell (1425027 → Pulsar Pro 22kw 7M). Not-found still 404-equivalent (status=not_found). SKU regression (CH02 → Cable Dock Daze, matched_by=sku) works. Frontend ChecklistPage: scanning 1427354 shows green '🟢 SERIALE RICONOSCIUTO' banner with 'Pulsar Pro Socket — SN 1427354', increments the Wallbox Pulsar Pro Socket row to qty 1 with the SN pushed. Second scan of 1427354 shows orange 'SERIALE GIÀ NELLA CHECKLIST'. CH02 SKU scan adds Cable Dock Daze qty 1. BOGUS_XYZ shows red 'PRODOTTO NON RICONOSCIUTO'. No shipments confirmed. 4/4 pytest + 4/4 frontend flows PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: lookup_receipts_sn paginates the entire Inventory Receipts DS (page_size=100) on every scan — O(N) per lookup. For a busy warehouse this will grow slowly; consider narrowing via Notion title 'contains' filter as a first-pass short-circuit before doing the full scan.

In server.py inventory_lookup, the 3-step pipeline (list_inventory + tracker_sn + receipts_sn) issues up to 3 sequential Notion API round-trips per scan — noticeable latency (~2-3s observed). Could be parallelized with asyncio.gather for tracker+receipts.

_parse_serials splits on '.', which also matches decimal-like tokens. Not an issue for numeric serials but worth documenting; a serial like '1.5' would be split into ['1','5']. Real wallbox SNs are integers so acceptable.
